description: Purpose: the 2026 catalogue of carbon-emissions metrology capacity - inspection parameters, measurement methods and reference standard devices published by SAMR. Guidelines: use when a question is about HOW a carbon quantity is measured (which instrument, which verification regulation, which reference device) rather than about an emission factor value. Limits: capacity/instrument catalogue, NOT an emission-factor database; filter with kind=params|methods|standard_devices + keyword. Ex: query_carbon_metrology(kind='params', keyword='温度').
